notes.title: V's Rage Demo- NEW VERSION
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2167530/Vs_Rage/]Two days ago we released the demo of V's Rage[/url]. Today we released a [b]new version[/b]: [i]you can access to both levels directly from the main menu[/i]!
This way you don't have to defeat the first level in order to access to the next one.

Don't forget to leave a review in the game's page if you played it. :)

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We've been working hard to get the demo out now! Is this a crazy idea? We hope not, but we need you!
Support us, put the game on the wishlist! Follow us! It costs you nothing and allows us to make our little big game even crazier!

notes.title: SUPPORT OUR NEW GAME!
notes.content:
After a year of hard work, today we launch our new game on Kickstarter!
V's RAGE is the essence of old school ARCADE and a healthy dose of Italian madness!
Support us! Love us! Or just follow us!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/newbix/vs-rage-an-arcade-game?ref=discovery]V's RAGE on Kickstarter[/url]

notes.title: A new game, a new team!
notes.content:
Hello, folks! I'm proud to announce you I'm developing a new game. This time I'm not working solo but I teamed up with two professional artists. It's looking AMAZING and it will be TWICE AS CRAZY.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2167530/Vs_Rage/][b]V's Rage[/b][/url] - that's the name of the new game.
We plan to release it on November 2023, but before we are launching a crowdfunding campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/newbix/vs-rage][b]Kickstarter[/b][/url].

The game is a hand-drawn action adventure inspired by arcade games from the '80es and it will be available both for Windows and MacOs.

I hope you will support us on this new journey!

notes.title: false positive in AVAST or other antivirus
notes.content:
The ASTEROIDES DRM and the "system" that verifies its originality within STEAM can result as a "troian" for some antivirus.
All DRM protected games simply access the internet to verify their originality and not to allow copying.
We are working to fix this, we have sent the executables to rule out the problem. In any case, when asked to run ASTEROIDES, confirm it without problems.
the bit ManiaX
